scoringCaveats: Knobs are the verbatim Comps-row values; null is recorded where the DB stores NULL - nothing was substituted. The three meaningful unset knobs are GroupScoreOption, GroupScoreDecimals and Drop1/Drop2AtRound.

Observed effective normalisation grid, pinned on all 199 rows by the stage verification and re-verified at curation: NormalisedScore == round(RawScore/groupMax*1000, 1 dp) half-up, i.e. points-basis per-group scaling rounded at one decimal. For F3K-family task 5, GS options 1 and 2 share the same code path (Scoring_MOD.vb:416-439), so the stored null GroupScoreOption cannot be distinguished between them observationally; the F3K UI additionally coerces option 2 to 1. Effective grid to use until WI-3 rules otherwise: option 1 semantics at Decs=1.

A stored NULL knob does not zero or stale GliderScore's persisted scores here (199/199 rows carry well-formed persisted values), which is why the faithful nulls are recorded rather than treated as an invalid fixture: GS substitutes an in-code default when loading config; the arithmetic story cites DBNull fallbacks on its config-read paths.

Drop1/Drop2AtRound are NULL while Drop3..5 are 99 and DropScoreOption=0. Unset drop configuration never fires drops - batch resolution from the comp-135 analysis ('drop config unset DB-wide => NO drops fire'); assumed here identically and left to WI-3's ladder reconstruction to honour.

series.evidence: CompSeriesNo='0' - this comp references no series entry at all (GliderScore's own default meaning 'no series'), so nothing can pull series data into any individual score.

teams.evidence: Scores carries no team columns; team standings are report-time aggregations of unchanged individual normalised scores, never an input to them. The team knobs are app defaults only: UseTeams=true/UseTeamProtection=true/NbrForTeamScore=3 are stored, but CompPilots.Team='0' on all 15 pilots - zero real team assignments exist in the data.
